args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Brightline Freight, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): this week's issue covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to the main article and a companion piece.
- Main article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Note: The newsletter's "mirror" link included a query parameter intended to carry an email address (base64-encoded). I did not use it; the companion piece was retrieved from its clean URL.
